game: NO@NYG Week 6 / kickoff not in pack / NYG +0.5 (NO -0.5) / total 46 / weather not saved

script.base: Books have a pick'em: NYG +0.5, total 46, implied about NO 23.25 and NYG 22.75. Base flow is a one-score game into the fourth, neither side abandoning the run. Skattebo keeps the early-down share he has had (51 carries, 177 rush yards over the last 3), Nabers (33 targets, 259 rec yards) and Likely (30 targets, 173) stay the passing spine, and NO splits carries across Miller 20/53, Kamara 19/71, Etienne 13/57 and Donaldson 8/36 while Olave (31 targets, 269 yards, 391 air) remains the shot WR.
script.flip1: NYG falls behind by 10+ and abandons the run, so Skattebo's carry count dies the way a trailing back's rushing line dies, while Nabers and Likely targets spike. A rush-only over dies; Skattebo rush+rec and a Nabers rec-yards over can still live.
script.flip2: Both QBs are bad when blitzed (NO EPA/dropback -0.22 on 76 blitzed dropbacks vs +0.06 clean; NYG -0.19 on 63 vs +0.24 clean) and the blitz rates are 40% NYG / 35% NO, so a pressure game or uncharted weather turns this into a sub-40 slog: deep air-yard pieces stall (Olave 391 air, Nabers 363, Vele 223, Mooney 171, Lance 192 air for only 7 yards) and short TE/RB catches become the offense.

injury_fallout: No injury report, practice trend, questionable tags, or inactives in the pack, so no next-man-up from a scratch can be named and final-inactives checkpoint cannot be run. Role fallout from the L3 counts only: NO has no bellcow (Miller 20 carries/53 yards, Kamara 19/71, Etienne 13/57, Donaldson 8/36 over 3 games), so an NO rush over needs a role jump the recent share does not show. NYG rush is Skattebo-led (51/177) with Harris the secondary back (24/91) and Tracy 5/8; Winston 5 carries/43 yards is spike-shaped, and a McCarthy rush prop exists but he is not in the L3 rusher line, so the QB is not confirmed. NO targets concentrate on Olave 31/269/391, then Vele 21/119/223 and Juwan Johnson 21/128/77; Fant is 5/40/18 and Kamara 10/34. NYG targets are a two-man game, Nabers 33/259/363 and Likely 30/173/238; Mooney 12/34/171 is air without production.

matchup.shell: Coverage shell not in the pack (no MOFO/MOFC, no man/zone rate). Location splits only: NYG allows 9.52 YPA in the middle on just 21 attempts vs 6.01 left (69 att) and 6.19 right (70 att). NO allows 8.28 left (64 att) and 8.88 middle (25 att) vs 6.27 right (62 att).
matchup.pressure: NYG blitzes 40%. NO QB is -0.22 EPA/dropback vs blitz (n=76) and only +0.06 clean, so pressure should cut NO deep yards and push checkdowns to Johnson (77 air yards on 21 targets) and the RBs. NO blitzes 35%. NYG QB is -0.19 vs blitz (n=63) and +0.24 clean, so about two-thirds of NYG dropbacks are the clean look where this offense has functioned.
matchup.bleeds: Both fronts leak on the ground: NYG 5.39 rush YPC allowed and 17 runs of 10+; NO 5.14 YPC and 19 runs of 10+. NYG has allowed only 11 passes of 20+ on 169 attempts; NO has allowed 14 on 163. NYG's pass leak is the middle, not the outside. NO's pass leak is left and middle plus explosives.
matchup.overlap: Nabers is NYG's top target by a slim margin over Likely (33 vs 30 targets) and his 363 air yards / 86.3 rec yards per game attack the side of the field NO actually gives up (left 8.28, middle 8.88, 14 explosives). Skattebo's 17-carry weekly role runs into that 5.14 YPC NO front. NO's matching piece would be Johnson's short routes into a 40% blitz and a middle bleed, but 128 yards on 21 targets is only 42.7 a game against a 40.5 line, so that overlap is noted and not bet.

form: Avoiding season averages. Skattebo L3: 51 carries, 177 rush yards (3.47 YPC, about 59 rush yards a game) plus 8 targets, 60 rec yards, 33 air — about 79 rush+rec a game, lead back not a committee. Harris 24/91 is the change-up, not the role. Nabers L3: 33 targets, 259 rec yards, 363 air (about 11 targets and 86 yards a game, 7.8 yards per target). Likely is close in volume (30/173/238, about 58 yards) but his 54 line has almost no cushion. Mooney 12 targets, 34 yards, 171 air is the non-connecting deep look. NO: Olave 31/269/391 (about 90 yards, 12.6 aDOT) is the production leader but into a 40% blitz and outside YPA that is not a bleed. Johnson 21/128/77 is the short TE. Kamara 19/71 rush and 10/34 rec is a split back at 3.74 YPC, essentially on his 24.5 rush line. Miller 20/53 (2.65 YPC, about 18 rush yards a game) is nowhere near a 36.5 rush line, which is a role-change warning, not a clean under, because NYG allows 5.39 YPC and per-game splits are missing. Lance 11 targets, 7 yards, 192 air is a failed deep shot. Winston 5/43 rush is one-play shaped. No similar-defense game logs beyond these opponent season rates.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Skattebo is the Giants' carry share (51 of the backfield carries, 177 rush yards plus 60 rec yards over the last 3, about 79 rush+rec a game) running into a Saints front that allows 5.14 YPC and 19 runs of 10+, and 53.5 sits about 25 yards under that recent role, with his rush average alone (59) already clearing the combo number.
edge_players.must_be_true: He plays his normal snap share in a game that stays within range of the pick'em so NYG does not go pass-only, and Harris does not take the early-down work (Harris is 24 carries to Skattebo's 51 in this window). No snap limit is in the pack to contradict that.
edge_players.kills_it: A multi-score deficit cuts him from ~17 carries toward 8-10 and the checkdowns do not come (only 8 targets / 60 rec yards in the L3, so the receiving floor is about 20), or a late scratch the pack does not have.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Nabers is the Giants' top target at 33 targets, 259 rec yards and 363 air yards over the last 3 (about 86 yards a game) into a Saints defense that allows 8.28 YPA left, 8.88 middle and 14 passes of 20+ yards, and 73 is about 13 yards under that role.
edge_players.must_be_true: He plays a full route share, the game does not become a NYG clock-kill, and enough dropbacks are the clean looks (NYG QB +0.24 EPA when not blitzed) that his 11-target role holds near 9+.
edge_players.kills_it: NO's 35% blitz (NYG QB -0.19 EPA on 63 blitzed dropbacks) turns the 363 air yards into incompletions, or NYG leads big and his targets fall to the 7 range where 7.8 yards per target misses 73.

data_check.notes: No projection, sim median, or Pinnacle no-vig in the pack, so step 8 cannot be priced and these are not 70% model legs. Available pre-kickoff numbers agree with both overs: Skattebo L3 rush+rec about 79 vs 53.5, and rush mean 59 already clears 53.5; NO rush defense 5.14 YPC and 19 explosive runs agrees. Nabers L3 about 86.3 vs 73, and NO left/middle YPA plus 14 explosives agree. The blitz EPA split is a risk inside the read, not a separate model saying the under. NO committee rush overs and Miller under 36.5 were not used: Miller's 17.7 rush yards a game disagrees with a 36.5 line but the bad NYG run defense and missing per-game splits mean that is a role warning, not a leg. Olave under 79.5 was a lean scheme read (40% blitz, 12.6 aDOT, outside YPA 6.0-6.2) that recent 89.7 yards disagree with, so it is dropped rather than flagged. Johnson over 40.5 only clears his 42.7 mean by 2 yards, so it is not a second leg.

market_rung_price: camskattebo rushrecyds over 53.5 at -113 (preferred to rushyds over 41.5 at -114 because the combo survives a pass-lean flip and his 59 rush-yard mean already clears 53.5). maliknabers recyds over 73, price not in pack (+nan), so the rung cannot be confirmed or moved. No alt rungs. No short-priced alts.
pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the 177 Skattebo rush yards were one spike game the pack does not split out, Harris took 15 carries, and NYG trailed by two scores without the dump-offs (8 targets in three games is a thin receiving floor, so 25 rush plus 15 rec misses 53.5). Nabers lost because NO blitzed at the 35% rate, the Giants' -0.19 blitz EPA showed up the way Lance's 192 air yards became 7 receiving yards, and a second-half lead cut him from 11 targets to 7. The +nan Nabers price may also mean 73 was never a real offer, and uncharted wind would have been the step that killed the deep half of his 363 air yards. That counter is live but not stronger than a lead back at 79 combo yards versus 53.5 and a WR1 at 86 versus 73 into a left/middle leak, so the legs stay.
slip_story: One story only: NYG offense in a pick'em that stays within one score, so Skattebo's carry share and Nabers' target share win together. It also survives the trail flip better than a rush-only ticket. Do not add a total under, a NYG rush under, Harris over 34.5, or NO deep overs (Olave 79.5, Vele 42.5) that need the blitz to fail. Johnson over 40.5 is the other-team blitz-checkdown idea and does not belong on this slip.
